independent_reference.method: Exact rational arithmetic over retained closes; 60-digit Decimal square root only for sample dispersion. Separate date and bucket reconstruction; no production calculator imported.

semantic_report_review.Q1: Resolved for this run: accepted worker reports, draft and final recap distinguish touching endpoints from positive interval overlap and do not infer independence.
semantic_report_review.Q2: Resolved for this run: all accepted outputs describe insufficient support without treating it as disconfirmation or absence of effect.
semantic_report_review.Q3: Resolved: one concrete bounded definition and full protocol, independently executed by reviewer, selected by hash and rendered by host; no unresolved parameter or alternative test.

Q4.finding: The researcher speculates that a larger supported sample might still have an interval straddling the margin, based on dispersion. It labels this an expectation, not measured inference, but the supplied evidence cannot justify a counterfactual interval; the reviewer does not challenge it.
Q4.disposition: Unsupported qualitative speculation, excluded from verified conclusions. It is not present in the host inference, canonical formula or final recap. Preserve the immutable report and this audit finding; no alpha or universal prose-validity claim.

semantic_report_review.timing_note: The compatibility execution_time label next_trading_day_close means the next returned observation in this bounded profile; actual dates and canonical formula are authoritative. Calendar completeness is explicitly unverified.
semantic_report_review.tie_note: The live sample has no exact threshold ties. Tie assignment is tested offline; do not claim the live run exercised a nonempty tie bucket.

limits: One real stock and ten historical unadjusted closes; no strategy P&L, official evaluation, publication or alpha acceptance.
Inference implementation has synthetic branch tests, not validated statistical coverage on market data.
Machine resources are the shared process tree, not isolated agent allocations.
